What the case study states, for the parent: the National Assembly's Budget Committee reversed a proposed cut and raised funding for civil registration services by 67% in the 2026 national budget (draft budget late 2025); a gap analysis with the Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship found the allocation 82% (K111.6 million, about USD 5.8 million in 2025) short of the National Strategic Plan's requirements; a 26-member Parliamentary Caucus on CRVS was launched in October 2025; 22% of under-fives have births registered (15% rural) and death registration is 28%, undated.
